newsitem.title: POLAND: KOMUNALNY PLANS GREATER BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: KOMUNALNY PLANS GREATER BOND ISSUE.

text.p: Polish Bank Komunalny SA wants to increase its planned convertible bond issue to 90 million zlotys from earlier planned 50 million zlotys, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
The bank also said it was considering to offer the bonds through a private placement and not through public offering as planned earlier.
The bond issue would be subject to a vote at a general shareholders' meeting on April 21.
Komunalny said more details on the issue should be available three weeks before the shareholders meeting.
